description: This PHP source file provides functions for CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) protection within the TestLink project. It includes functions for managing session variables, generating and validating CSRF tokens, replacing forms in HTML to include CSRF hidden fields, and filtering template content for CSRF security.

methods.name: store_in_session
methods.description: Stores a key/value pair into the PHP session; returns true on success.

methods.name: unset_session
methods.description: Removes a key from the PHP session.

methods.name: get_from_session
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the PHP session by key.

methods.name: csrfguard_generate_token
methods.description: Generates a CSRF token for a unique form name, stores it in session, and returns it.

methods.name: csrfguard_validate_token
methods.description: Validates a given CSRF token against the stored session token for a given form name.

methods.name: csrfguard_replace_forms
methods.description: Replaces HTML forms with versions that include hidden CSRF token fields, using regex matching.

methods.name: smarty_csrf_filter
methods.description: A content filter for Smarty templates to apply CSRF form replacements.

methods.name: csrfguard_start
methods.description: Validates CSRF tokens in POST requests and redirects to error pages if invalid.
